scenario_count.formula: count(complete scenario cards in proposal.md section 'AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景')
assumptions: Scenario cards are concept proposals for professional deepening, not approved operations.

test_validation_scenario_count.formula: count(test/validation scenarios declared in proposal.md scenario cards)
assumptions: Test scenarios are concept proposals requiring organizer approval and safety review before any pilot.

case_study_count.formula: count(international AI innovation ecosystem case studies with source and license records)
assumptions: Cases are desk-research summaries from cited public sources; they are reference benchmarks, not commitments.

landmark_count.formula: count(AI pilgrimage landmark concepts in proposal.md)
assumptions: Landmarks are concept proposals subject to heritage, safety, and rights clearance.

component_count.formula: count(public space component library entries in proposal.md)
assumptions: Component library entries are concept-level design components with stated safety/heritage/accessibility/O&M boundaries.
